name: The Candle Spent at Both Ends

body.label: Target
body.html: Self and one willing ally within 3 units, or self alone.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Burn 1 additional Action Die. Each target reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn and gains +1 Harmony against the next attack targeting it in that time.

surges.html: Each target resists its next 2 units of forced movement until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Rite - Offering
rider.html: Rite, 2 Echoes: bind one target. Trigger: it finishes a turn without changing spaces. Echo: suppress one ordinary Success Die penalty on its next card before your next turn.
